items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But I met him in 1962, when the Beatles came for the first time to the States. ... I went to meet him in the Plaza Hotel.

ctx.x: I was gonna say, Toots, was that, you know, later in your career… Well, at least on paper, you started doing many more things that were outside of jazz. You know, pop, like the Billy Joel and, you know… And there’s a quote here that in 1959, John Lennon came to see you perform. Do you remember that?
Not John Lennon. He didn’t see me perform. He saw… Are you taping?
